assumptions: Elapsed running intervals use continuous time prorating; billing rounding/minimums and timestamp uncertainty are not an invoice reconciliation.
GB-Mo prorated by UTC calendar-month length; byte conversion uses 2^30 bytes per storage/transfer GB-equivalent and is stated explicitly.
S3 Standard and outbound transfer use the highest first-tier recorded rate; account aggregation/discounts can reduce those rates.
No free-tier allowance is assumed unless confirmed_free_bytes_applied is supplied; no tax, support plan, credits or discounts inferred.
Stopped EC2 ends compute time but retains chargeable EBS unless deletion is confirmed. Retained public addresses need their actual chargeable interval.
Archive inventory must include all task-owned copies, noncurrent versions and incomplete multipart parts; multipart/list/restore verification requests and internet downloads are separate inputs.
No cost is inferred for pre-existing unrelated resources, and no AWS operation is performed.
compute_network_scope: EC2 + task gp3 + public IPv4 + internet data transfer; S3 storage/requests additionally enter the incremental total

line_items.timestamp_basis: ESTIMATE: AWS_RESOURCES.created_utc is inventory creation, not a verified launch/running transition; replace if actual task launch receipt is available
Recorded resized start and original shutdown journal time; billing transition precision covered by explicit contingency.
Conservative rounded restart request from CLOSEOUT_RESUME_20260922.json through API-confirmed termination, not an exact invoice transition.

line_items.inventory_basis: Conservative final all-version bytes plus16MiB reserved for final proof tail, charged for the entire episode since earliest object; includes noncurrent versions. No incomplete multipart uploads.

line_items.basis: 100000 requests in each category as conservative allowance; not measured request count
100000 requests in each category as conservative allowance; not measured request count

line_items.description: Internet data transfer out, first paid tier estimate
line_items.basis: 50GiB budget allowance; not measured internet egress

line_items.description: Explicit contingency allowance for billable API usage, sub-minute transition uncertainty and incidental task charges; not a measured charge

CURRENT_PRICES.json.source: AWS Price List Query API AmazonEC2 us-east-1

retention_scope: recurring estimates are separate from elapsed episode charges; indefinite retention has no finite total-cost ceiling

unrelated_instance.reason: Unrelated running instance is outside this task; its usage and costs are unknown

estimation_policy: Complete conservative budget estimate using observed resources and declared usage allowances. All cost categories are represented; request/transfer/timestamp uncertainty is not invoice-reconciled. Allowances are estimates, not proven billing upper bounds.
network_metric_scope: EC2 all outbound includes same-region transfers and can have ingestion lag; it is not billable internet egress.
